historical_test: Cashew official test already observed; prohibited for this prototype; historical artifacts immutable
preprocessing: full-frame RGB bilinear antialiased square128, float32 /255; ImageNet channel mean [.485,.456,.406], std [.229,.224,.225]; no crop. Deliberate localization/CPU deviation from classification resize256/center224.
features: frozen eval-mode ResNet18 stem/layer1 -> layer2 [128,16,16], layer3 [256,8,8]; each 3x3 stride1 padding1 average pooling including padding; bilinear layer3 to16 with align_corners=False; concatenate384 channels; no feature normalization/projection

memory.ordering: sorted sample_id; row-major patches; per-ID randperm256 seeded first8 big-endian bytes SHA256(42|sample_id), first16 then sorted; fixed sampling not greedy coreset

scoring.patch: RMS Euclidean distance to closest memory patch, sqrt(clamp(sum(q^2)+sum(b^2)-2q.b,0)/384)
scoring.pixel: bilinear patch grid ->128x128, align_corners=False; no smoothing

development.threshold: calibration normals only, q=.95 linear float64, strict score > threshold; no pixel threshold
development.synthetic: first16 validation IDs only; one16x16 magenta/green checkerboard of4x4 cells each, top-left y=40+SHA256(pseudo-v1|ID)[0]%33, x=40+digest[1]%33; synthetic mask exactly overwritten square
development.synthetic_metrics: paired score changes, frozen-threshold trigger counts, pooled synthetic pixel AUROC/AP, peak-in-mask count; no claim about real defect accuracy and no historical model comparison
development.no_tuning: one recipe, one fit, no parameter search or refit based on validation/pseudo scores

resources.latency: first normal validation image, batch1, 5warmups30repeats; separate feature extraction, memory search/map, total preloaded inference and30decode/resize repeats; median/p95

prohibited: Cashew official test image/mask reads or new model scoring
rights: torchvision code BSD-3-Clause; pretrained dataset-derived rights separate; local research only, no blanket commercial permission asserted
outputs: ignored runs/cashew-feature-v1; normal score IDs, patch selection, memory/hash/recipe/source provenance, synthetic-only examples/results, timing
